maria_h: Heads-up — after today's canary we're seeing +9% P95 decode latency on host side for short-chat workloads. Perf trace attached: https://perf.internal/fg/1930123456 :eyes:
perf-bot: Flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.internal/fg/1930123456
aj: where is the time going? stack?
maria_h: main culprits: JSON parse and tokenization passes. Quick breakdown from CPU sampling: parse/req-parse ~1.1ms, tokenizer ~0.6ms, streaming chunk boundary handling ~0.3ms; KV-cache lookups show extra misses for 8-char prefixes (thrashing).
deepak: KV thrash could be from chunk splitting: if streaming chunks don't align with token boundaries we produce different prefix keys. Did waveform change in ingress? Any change in chunker config?
sasha: we shipped small change to chunker (coalesce=false) to reduce memory; might be the cause.
aj: ok, let's try re-enabling coalescing for low-latency tier only + add an explicit prefix normalization before kv lookup (hash the last N tokens).
maria_h: I can prototype normalize step in C++ host preproc. pseudocode:
```
// normalize key
if (chunk.size() < MIN_PREFIX) pad_with_zeroes();
key = sha1(prefix);
kv.get(key);
```
should be cheap.
deepak: careful — extra hashing adds CPU. Maybe better to canonicalize by joining tokens on whitespace and truncating to 64 bytes before lookup.
sasha: also try moving JSON parse to a fast-path: if request has single top-level field `prompt` and length < 2048, use a FFI fast-parse that extracts value without full DOM.
maria_h: good point. I can add heuristic: if request starts with `{` and contains `"prompt":` within first 120 bytes, use fast path.
aj: let's triage: 1) roll back chunker change for canary, 2) run microbenchmark for KV key normalization vs sha1 vs truncation, 3) add JSON fast-path. who owns?
maria_h: I'll do 1+3 today. deepak takes microbench.
deepak: ack. I'll add harness: `scripts/bench_kvnorm.sh --mode=trunc|sha1|none`
perf-bot: perf test queued: https://perf.internal/job/1930123456
ken: FYI gRPC vs HTTP2 perf difference here is negligible for these short requests; focus host CPU.
sasha: also add metric: count of KV key variants per session to detect thrash.
maria_h: noted. I'll open a PR with draft change and put link here when ready :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary rollback scheduled if P95 > baseline+5% for next 30m :rotating_light:
